subject.title: feat(sessions): add local timezone prefix to archive filenames

question: Should OpenClaw bless the `YYYY-MM-DD_<utc-stamp>` reset/delete archive filename contract for configured timezones, and require all archive consumers to support it before merge?
rationale: This changes a persisted session artifact naming contract and touches session-history discovery, usage accounting, cleanup, QMD export identity, and possible user scripts; automation cannot choose that product/upgrade boundary alone.

options.title: Finish Option B before merge
options.body: Keep the local-date prefix plus UTC suffix, but require QMD/archive-reader coverage and real reset/delete proof before landing.

options.title: Defer QMD and accept narrower scope
options.body: Accept the reset/delete basename change now and knowingly leave QMD-normalized archive-hit support for a follow-up.

options.title: Pause filename policy
options.body: Keep the linked feature request open and pause this PR until maintainers choose a different archive filename or metadata strategy.

recommendation.title: Finish Option B before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the local-date prefix plus UTC suffix, but require QMD/archive-reader coverage and real reset/delete proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: He is already requested in the PR discussion and has direct merged history on the archive usage/parser surface affected by this filename contract.
